report:
Oropharynx, left tonsil, transoral resection and neck dissection

Received in formalin is a transoral resection specimen measuring 40 x 30 x 20 mm. There is an ulcerated tumour in the left tonsil measuring 28 x 20 x 12 mm, 6 mm from the closest (deep) margin. The margins are inked. Representative sections are taken in 8 blocks.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Transoral resection and neck dissection
- Tumour site: Palatine tonsil, left
- Tumour size: 28 mm (greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Squamous cell carcinoma, non-keratinising, HPV-associated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is an HPV-associated non-keratinising squamous cell carcinoma. Sheets and nests of cells with a high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, oval to spindled hyperchromatic nuclei and indistinct cell borders show little or no keratinisation.
- Tumour extent: No extension beyond the primary site
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- HPV status by p16 immunohistochemistry: Positive
- HPV PCR: Positive (HPV 16)

Margins
- Invasive tumour: All margins negative
  - Closest margin: 6 mm (deep)

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 32 examined; 2 involved
  - Extranodal extension: Not identified
  - Size of largest metastatic deposit: 25 mm, level IIA
  - Laterality: Ipsilateral (including midline)

Pathological stage (AJCC 9th edition)
- pTNM: pT2 pN1b

Additional findings
- None identified

OROPHARYNX, left tonsil, transoral resection and neck dissection
- SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA, NON-KERATINISING, HPV-ASSOCIATED, 28 mm; p16 and HPV
  PCR positive; completely excised (closest margin 6 mm, deep); see synoptic
  report
- 2 of 32 regional lymph nodes involved
- pT2 pN1b (AJCC 9th edition)
